role: Runs after slide descriptions are generated and before image generation; blocks prompts that do not explicitly carry face structure, expression, clothing, and cross-slide identity continuity.

slides.copy: You’re missing from so many of my memories.

identity_continuity.face_structure: Match the real face structure from the selected identity bundle for both people: recurring facial proportions, hairline, jaw/cheek shape, eyes, brows, nose, smile, and relative height/posture. Do not substitute generic Indian couple faces.
identity_continuity.facial_expression: Keep the facial expression specific to this beat (quiet discovery) while preserving the same underlying face structure across all slides.
identity_continuity.clothing: Use story-relevant clothes, dupatta/shawl/shirt colors, accessories, and body-language cues from the identity bundle when visible; keep outfit continuity intentional instead of inventing random wardrobe changes.
identity_continuity.cross_slide_consistency: The illustrated couple must read as the same Anchal/Aachu and Himanshu/Zuv in every slide, with consistent faces, hair, body proportions, and relationship energy.
